brief:
Israeli forces shot and killed a 14-year-old Palestinian during a military raid on the Askar refugee camp, located east of Nablus, according to a medical source cited by Al Jazeera. The child was struck by gunfire as troops conducted operations in the densely populated camp.

The incident marks another casualty amid ongoing Israeli military operations in the occupied West Bank. Details about what prompted the use of lethal force remain unclear, and no immediate statement was available from Israeli military officials regarding the circumstances of the shooting.

title: Israeli forces shoot 14-year-old dead during Nablus raid
